correctness.rationale: Normal-form necessity follows from operation preservation and additivity of binary fiber shifts; sufficiency is direct substitution. Rank-k linear maps and coset occupancy give the full E polynomial. Composition gives L^2=L, Lc=0 and b_{Lp+c}=(I+L)b_p; projection complements and fiber counting give I. The included Python checker directly enumerated all 256 set maps for r=1 and all 16384 normal-form maps for r=2, with operation, image and idempotence checks; r=3 polynomial total checked. Finite checks supplement the all-parameter proof.

value.rationale: A complete natural Hom-set image spectrum and idempotent image spectrum for all ranks reveal sharp power-of-four retract rigidity that fails for generic endomorphism images. At r=2 there are endomorphisms of image size 2,3,6,8 but no such retractions. The rank dependence and exact multiplicities offer a meaningful boundary for nonconnected Alexander-quandle homomorphisms and subquandle retract questions, not a single artificial finite sample.
